timestamp_derivation: Computed from the session clock after the fix was validated, before the commit that introduces this receipt.
authorisation: D81, the Product Owner's mission of 2026-10-29.
finding: Deploying T0267 to the test appliance 172.21.96.97 with appliance-install.sh --upgrade stopped at migration 0162: permission denied for table tenants. Migrations are applied as the least-privilege role iam_v2_owner, which holds no CREATE on public by design, and five of the new migrations (0163, 0166, 0173, 0174, 0178) change the platform schema. The full-schema harness applied migrations as the superuser, so it could not see this. The upgrade stopped safely: 0159-0161 applied, 0162 not applied, no binary replaced.
fix: A migration that must change the platform schema carries '-- edge-migrate: platform'. apply-pending-migrations.sh applies only those as the platform role through edge-migrate.sh --platform-migration, which lifts only the live-site role gates (non-superuser, no public CREATE, no ledger UPDATE) and only for one named migration whose marker is present and whose content is pinned by sha256; the backup, advisory locks, gap check and ledger row are unchanged. The tenants notify trigger is also created by Gate-P. The full-schema harness can now build from an earlier baseline and apply migrations as the live apply role (FULLSCHEMA_APPLY_ROLE).
verification: A local upgrade path built from the previous baseline with every migration applied as the live apply role (platform ones as the superuser) reaches 0178 and reconciles Gate-P; the migration-runner selftest passes with 59 cases including case 13 (refused without the marker, refused without a pinned sha256, the least-privilege role still cannot change public, a marked and pinned migration applies and records its ledger row).
deployment: At the time of this receipt the test appliance is at migration 0161 with the previous release's binaries; Central runs release ee2faf881d89 (recorded by the deployment receipt).
